money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any Nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; original EMD to be submitted by 17.08.2026 1500 hrs.
